title: Baked Irish Stroopwafel Gratin
description: A fusion dessert combining the sweetness of Irish stroopwafels with a crunchy baked gratin topping.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and baking powder.
Cut the softened butter into the dry ingredients until a crumbly mixture forms.
Press the mixture evenly into the bottom of a 9x9-inch baking dish.
Bake the crust for 20-25 minutes, or until lightly golden brown.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the heavy cream and 1/2 cup of sugar.
Pour the cream mixture over the baked crust.
Arrange the Irish stroopwafels on top of the cream mixture.
In a small bowl, mix together the remaining 1/2 cup of sugar and 1/4 cup of granulated sugar.
Sprinkle the sugar mixture evenly over the stroopwafels.
Return the dish to the oven and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5-10 minutes before serving.
